perturbations.alias: gene symbol replaced by the gene's NCBI full name, taken from AlzKB (Gene.xrefNcbiGene = PrimeKG GeneProtein.id); PrimeKG itself stores no full name

strata: relation path (which fixes the start type), proportional allocation over eligible questions
